beats.text: In Moldova, women are 54.0% of the population. In Qatar, just 28.9%.
Qatar is the world's lowest, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
Other Gulf nations sit near the bottom: Saudi Arabia has 39.6%, Kuwait 38.9%, Oman 37.6%, and UAE 36.2%.
Russia sits near the top, where women make up 53.6%.
The 2 biggest superpowers both tilt male: USA has 49.8%, and China has 49.1%.
